<a id="EditorDock"></a>

# EditorDock

**Experimental:** This class may be changed or removed in future versions.

**Inherits:** [MarginContainer](MarginContainer.md) **\<** [Container](Container.md) **\<** [Control](Control.md) **\<** [CanvasItem](CanvasItem.md) **\<** [Node](Node.md) **\<** [Object](Object.md)

**Inherited By:** [FileSystemDock](FileSystemDock.md)

Dockable container for the editor.

<!-- classref-introduction-group -->

## Description

EditorDock is a [Container](Container.md) node that can be docked in one of the editor's dock slots. Docks are added by plugins to provide space for controls related to an [EditorPlugin](EditorPlugin.md). The editor comes with a few built-in docks, such as the Scene dock, FileSystem dock, etc.

You can add a dock by using [EditorPlugin.add_dock()](EditorPlugin.md#EditorPlugin_method_add_dock). The dock can be customized by changing its properties.

```
    @tool
    extends EditorPlugin

    # Dock reference.
    var dock

    # Plugin initialization.
    func _enter_tree():
        dock = EditorDock.new()
        dock.title = "My Dock"
        dock.dock_icon = preload("./dock_icon.png")
        dock.default_slot = EditorPlugin.DOCK_SLOT_RIGHT_UL
        var dock_content = preload("./dock_content.tscn").instantiate()
        dock.add_child(dock_content)
        add_dock(dock)

    # Plugin clean-up.
    func _exit_tree():
        remove_dock(dock)
        dock.queue_free()
        dock = null
```

## Enumerations

<a id="enum_EditorDock_DockLayout"></a>

<!-- classref-enumeration -->

flags **DockLayout**: [🔗](#enum_EditorDock_DockLayout)

<a id="EditorDock_constant_DOCK_LAYOUT_VERTICAL"></a>

<!-- classref-enumeration-constant -->

[DockLayout](EditorDock.md#enum_EditorDock_DockLayout) **DOCK_LAYOUT_VERTICAL** = `1`

Allows placing the dock in the vertical dock slots on either side of the editor.

\ **Note:** Currently this flag has no effect because the bottom panel is not a proper dock slot. This means that the dock can always be vertical.<a id="EditorDock_constant_DOCK_LAYOUT_HORIZONTAL"></a>

<!-- classref-enumeration-constant -->

[DockLayout](EditorDock.md#enum_EditorDock_DockLayout) **DOCK_LAYOUT_HORIZONTAL** = `2`

Allows placing the dock in the editor's bottom panel. Implement [_update_layout()](EditorDock.md#EditorDock_private_method__update_layout) to handle changing layouts.<hr class="classref-section-separator"/>

## Property Descriptions

<a id="EditorDock_property_available_layouts"></a>

<!-- classref-property -->

**BitField**\[[DockLayout](EditorDock.md#enum_EditorDock_DockLayout)\] **available_layouts** = `1` [🔗](#EditorDock_property_available_layouts)

<!-- classref-property-setget -->

- `void` **set_available_layouts**\ (\ value\: **BitField**\[[DockLayout](EditorDock.md#enum_EditorDock_DockLayout)\]\ )
- **BitField**\[[DockLayout](EditorDock.md#enum_EditorDock_DockLayout)\] **get_available_layouts**\ (\ )

The available layouts for this dock, as a bitmask.

If you want to make all layouts available, use ``available_layouts = DOCK_LAYOUT_VERTICAL | DOCK_LAYOUT_HORIZONTAL``.

<hr class="classref-item-separator"/>

<a id="EditorDock_property_default_slot"></a>

<!-- classref-property -->

[DockSlot](EditorPlugin.md#enum_EditorPlugin_DockSlot) **default_slot** = `-1` [🔗](#EditorDock_property_default_slot)

<!-- classref-property-setget -->

- `void` **set_default_slot**\ (\ value\: [DockSlot](EditorPlugin.md#enum_EditorPlugin_DockSlot)\ )
- [DockSlot](EditorPlugin.md#enum_EditorPlugin_DockSlot) **get_default_slot**\ (\ )

The default dock slot used when adding the dock with [EditorPlugin.add_dock()](EditorPlugin.md#EditorPlugin_method_add_dock).

After the dock is added, it can be moved to a different slot and the editor will automatically remember its position between sessions. If you remove and re-add the dock, it will be reset to default.

## Method Descriptions

<a id="EditorDock_private_method__load_layout_from_config"></a>

<!-- classref-method -->

`void` **_load_layout_from_config**\ (\ config\: [ConfigFile](ConfigFile.md), section\: [String](String.md)\ ) <span class="virtual">virtual</span> [🔗](#EditorDock_private_method__load_layout_from_config)

Implement this method to handle loading this dock's layout. It's equivalent to [EditorPlugin._set_window_layout()](EditorPlugin.md#EditorPlugin_private_method__set_window_layout). `section` is a unique section based on [layout_key](EditorDock.md#EditorDock_property_layout_key).

Implement this method to handle saving this dock's layout. It's equivalent to [EditorPlugin._get_window_layout()](EditorPlugin.md#EditorPlugin_private_method__get_window_layout). `section` is a unique section based on [layout_key](EditorDock.md#EditorDock_property_layout_key).

<hr class="classref-item-separator"/>

<a id="EditorDock_private_method__update_layout"></a>

<!-- classref-method -->

`void` **_update_layout**\ (\ layout\: [int](int.md)\ ) <span class="virtual">virtual</span> [🔗](#EditorDock_private_method__update_layout)

Implement this method to handle the layout switching for this dock. `layout` is one of the [DockLayout](EditorDock.md#enum_EditorDock_DockLayout) constants.

```
    _update_layout(layout):
        box_container.vertical = (layout == DOCK_LAYOUT_VERTICAL)
```
